instructions: This bash script is about to be run as the user, in the user's home directory. Can running it delete or modify existing user data in $HOME (files, directories, their contents or permissions)? Creating new files is not destructive, unless it can replace or overwrite an existing file. Only commands that actually execute count: text that is merely printed, commented out or written to a file outside $HOME is harmless.

criteria.destructive: it can delete, overwrite, truncate, move away or modify existing files under $HOME
criteria.safe: it only reads, prints, or creates new files, or only touches paths outside $HOME
criteria.unknown: it runs scripts, programs, downloaded or encoded code whose contents are not shown, so what it does can't be determined
